metadata.comment: The seam. A JSON array with ONE programme object: { projectName, problemStatement, endsOn, entries[] }. An entry is { id, kind, at, anchor, state, position, programmeId, ...the kind's own fields } — id namespaced by kind ("lesson:<conceptId>", "session:<uuid>"), because two tables produce the same uuid space and a key collision renders one row and drops the other. `at` is null when an entry genuinely has no moment, which is honest rather than a gap. When the backend lands, a query replaces this node and the outputs stay the same.

nodes.label: Split the programme into its parts

metadata.comment: One calculation, one code node (doctrine 8). Static Data may hand rows as runtime Models rather than plain objects, so plain() unwraps whichever arrives — the same helper Data/Fixture lesson uses.
